name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A disclosure stack: a column of headers whose panels open and close. Wraps @base-ui/react/accordion — Base UI owns the open state (single or multiple), the keyboard model and every piece of the accordion ARIA.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/accordion

Installed to `components/ui/accordion.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/accordion';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/accordion

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
